description: Open a payment dispute: pass payment_id and amount, and optionally currency (default USD), customer_id, reason, status (default open) and metadata. Workspace owners and admins are emailed and subscribed endpoints get dispute.opened. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: create_dispute
